task:
V3 DOCUMENTATION AUTHORITY REBASELINE AND RETIREMENT. Work only on the target docs branch created from exact main 329e081db9a55d9cce24da5b8ac4f58216a10e8a. This is independent of PR #601 and must not write to migration/svelte-go-live-candidate. No production access, deployment, database access/write, secrets, service changes, or application feature implementation. Preserve unrelated work.

GOAL
Make ED-Finder documentation understandable from a small current authority set, while preserving historical decisions as clearly historical evidence rather than letting Stage 17-26 and old map plans compete with V3 truth. A developer/agent should be able to read roughly 6-8 current documents and understand the V3 programme. Retire aggressively but safely: archive/reclassify old docs and repair references/tests rather than deleting useful history.

CURRENT FACTS THAT MUST BE REFLECTED
- Hetzner/V2 is gone; production is ed-finder-prod / nb79a3d.mevnode.com with PostgreSQL 18. Old V2 host/runtime/cron/database receipts are historical only.
- Contabo is definitely the three self-hosted Codex runner host. It is NOT production and is NOT automatically the live-checkpoint destination. A separate read-only capacity audit found a small checkpoint could be feasible only with limits/isolation; checkpoint destination remains a deployment decision, not architectural truth. Remove hard-coded 'Contabo live-checkpoint environment' claims from current authority docs.
- The target browser stack is apps/web Svelte/SvelteKit + fresh Babylon. React/R3F/Three is historical migration/behavior evidence only, not V3 target and not current production authority. Preserve the historical fact that R3F won Stage 26, but do not let current docs say R3F constrains or remains the production renderer after V2 decommission.
- PR #601 is the single active V3 application integration lane. At current known #601 head 190d26446a2487596299cbb6b497ffa5201fee0b it already contains a real Explore/Finder -> fresh Babylon results -> canonical Inspect product slice. Therefore current docs saying #601 is foundation-only/non-product or that Finder/Inspect/fresh map design 'come later' are stale. Since this docs branch is based on main, phrase #601 implementation as active PR state, not as code already merged to main.
- Current browser rule: Product E2E/Visual Acceptance and Review Lab are separate; both V3 map lanes must use apps/web+Babylon. Review Lab synthetic data/environment may differ.
- Search/spatial-data and derived-data bootstrap are currently under explicit redesign/audit. Normal Finder currently uses raw x/y/z bounding/distance and does not make grid_cell_id a first-class accelerator. Do NOT prematurely canonize a new grid/cluster design in this docs cleanup. Instead record an explicit current decision gate: Search requirements -> spatial index/grid/cluster design -> PG18 derived-data bootstrap.
- Likewise do not trigger or prescribe a full PG18 Ratings/grid/clusters build here. Current code still uses Ratings v3.4 in places while the roadmap previously declared archetypes the intended judgement layer. Record this as a current architecture/data decision to resolve before a full derived-data bootstrap, rather than inventing a resolution.
- Ollama was experimental residue used only to test whether local inference could power Octopus and has now been removed from production. Do not retain it as architecture.

SMALL CURRENT AUTHORITY SET
Rework the docs so the primary current authority set is approximately:
1. root README.md — concise entry point and authority links, not a giant history dump.
2. docs/ROADMAP.md — current state + near-term programme/order/decision gates only; move or link long historical narrative elsewhere.
3. docs/development/v3-application-stack-decision.md — technology authority; update current-state wording but keep durable stack decisions.
4. docs/colonisation-redesign/spatial-platform-product-contract.md — product/spatial feature authority.
5. docs/colonisation-redesign/spatial-platform-architecture-decision.md — renderer-neutral architecture/ownership authority; update implementation-status language without rewriting historical Stage 26 facts.
6. docs/development/v3-browser-validation-lanes.md — browser authority; update stale current-state wording.
7. docs/operations/infrastructure-status.md — infrastructure/runtime authority.
CLAUDE.md remains the agent/repository contract that points to this chain, not a competing product roadmap.

SUPPORTING / NON-PRIMARY DOCS
- docs/development/v3-coordination-control-plane.md may remain as a supporting process/coordination document, but demote it from product/application authority and remove hard-coded Contabo checkpoint topology.
- Stage 27A capability/readiness/inheritance audits remain useful evidence inputs but should be clearly 'audit/evidence', not current roadmap/authorization gates.
- Do not create a final Search/Grid/Cluster authority document yet; active audits are intended to inform it. Add a clear placeholder/decision gate in ROADMAP/current index.

RETIREMENT / ARCHIVE WORK
Inventory docs/, docs/colonisation-redesign/, docs/superpowers/plans/, docs/superpowers/specs/, root README/CHANGES/CLAUDE/.claude-session-context, and doc-governance tests.
- Clearly classify historical Stage 25 and Stage 26 roadmap/contracts/closeouts as history. Preserve content/decision chronology.
- Archive or reclassify old map-specific Superpowers plans/specs (R3F split, exploration-layer plan/spec, real-star streaming phases, glow/body-thumbnail map plan, August-16 Babylon 6 narrow plan, and similar superseded map implementation plans) so none appears to be current V3 authority.
- Prefer actual git moves into a coherent docs/archive hierarchy when reference/test repair is bounded and safe. If a file has dense active dependencies that make a move risky in this tranche, keep it in place but add an unmistakable historical status and remove it from active indexes. Do not mass-move blindly.
- Create/update docs/archive/README.md (or equivalent) explaining that archived docs preserve historical decisions/evidence and never override current authority.
- Shrink docs/colonisation-redesign/README.md drastically: current authority first, a small supporting-evidence section, archive pointer. It must no longer present dozens of Stage 17-26 files as 'Active Docs'.
- .claude-session-context.md is session residue, not durable authority. If no live contract requires it, remove it or archive it clearly; update any references/tests.
- CHANGES.md remains historical changelog; do not rewrite history. Add/rebaseline its current V3 framing if needed so historical Stage/V2 wording cannot be read as current authority.

ROADMAP REWRITE TARGET
Make docs/ROADMAP.md significantly shorter and operational. Desired structure:
- Authority / current baseline
- Current V3 state (prod infra, stack, PR #601 active state, no React production assumption)
- Current product journey and spatial north star
- Current execution order / next milestones (browser stabilization, Python3.14/release hardening, merge/checkpoint, data/search decisions, etc.)
- Active decision gates (Search/spatial index/grid/clusters; scoring/archetype vs Ratings dependencies; PG18 derived-data bootstrap; checkpoint destination; V3 DB maintenance/recovery evidence)
- Deferred/later product capabilities (Commander History/Journal, System Map, Powerplay, Routes, CRE/CPE, Digital Twin etc.) with links to product contract rather than large duplicated prose
- Historical pointer
Move lengthy Stage 25/26/audit history out of the current roadmap or compress it to short links. Do not destroy provenance.

SPATIAL PRODUCT CONTENT TO PRESERVE
Ensure the active product/architecture docs retain the valuable future requirements already present across Stage 26/27 evidence, including where appropriate:
- one continuous Galaxy spatial context; true Elite LY coordinates; wide/regional/local/system semantic scales; 42 named regions; explicit bounded/truncated responses; highlighted/selected systems survive LOD; accessible parallel DOM; overlap disambiguation; camera/selection continuity; search/fly-to/picking;
- Finder/search-from-here, systems-within, region/viewport/reference inputs, radius visualization/sync, map/result handoff; Finder remains query/ranking owner;
- clusters as a domain-derived contribution, not renderer truth;
- Commander History/Journal, Routes, Powerplay, Colonisation, CPE PLANNED overlays and CRE Digital Twin contributions;
- System Map truth/fidelity rules, BodyRef identity, schematic orbits when current phase unavailable, infrastructure association uncertainty;
- representation classes and no renderer-owned mechanics/ranking/persistence/planning.
Do not re-import obsolete Stage 25 'Explore-only forever' restrictions that Stage 27 already superseded.

TEST / GOVERNANCE CLEANUP
Current tests such as tests/test_v3_application_stack_decision.py hard-code stale Stage 27A/R3F authorization phrases. Update governance tests so they protect DURABLE V3 invariants rather than obsolete stage status. Examples of durable assertions:
- apps/web is sole browser destination; Svelte owns app/domain/accessible DOM; Babylon types do not leak; Babylon is fresh V3 renderer target; React/R3F are historical migration evidence only;
- production/current authority is V3, not Hetzner/V2;
- current docs authority chain is explicit and small;
- archived docs cannot be presented as current roadmap authority;
- checkpoint target is not hard-coded to Contabo;
- Product E2E vs Review Lab split remains;
- no docs claim #601 is foundation-only after Finder/Inspect product slice landed on that PR.
Add a focused current-docs authority/index test if useful. Keep tests robust to normal wording edits; avoid replacing one brittle phrase museum with another.

LINKS / REFERENCES
Use git mv where moving files. Repair relative Markdown links, code/test path references, README/ROADMAP/CLAUDE links, and any docs indexes. Search the entire repo for moved paths and stale phrases. Do not leave broken references. Historical source code comments may point to moved docs; update those references only if path-only/mechanical, not product logic.

VALIDATION
Run at least:
- python3 scripts/resolve_project_state.py --strict (or canonical current equivalent);
- git diff --check;
- targeted documentation/governance pytest tests including test_v3_application_stack_decision.py and any docs/index tests touched/added;
- repository-wide search for stale current-authority phrases: 'Contabo live-checkpoint', 'R3F remains production', 'Finder/Inspect ... come later', '27A ... only authorizes 27B', and old active Stage 25/26 claims outside clearly archived/historical documents;
- a Markdown relative-link/reference check using existing repo tooling if present; otherwise write/run a bounded validation helper without adding a new dependency unless justified;
- ensure no application/runtime behavior changes.

FINAL REPORT
Return exact starting/final SHA; concise list of primary current authority docs; files moved/archived/reclassified; major stale contradictions fixed; governance tests changed; any historical files intentionally left in place and why; link/test validation results; and explicit confirmation no product code/runtime/DB/prod/Contabo mutation occurred.
